t: This was the Almost Free Theatre, an alternative and fringe theatre on Rupert Street in Soho. It was set up in 1971 by E. D. Berman, an American actor and social activist who settled in Britain. Berman is a community educator, poet, playwright and producer. In 1979 the Queen appointed Berman a Member of the Order of the British Empire for services to community education and community arts. Their work includes city farms and the Inter-Action organisation, which ran many creative community projects.
